## 2. Core Services Overview
1. **Dhikala Zone Canter Safari:**
   - Vehicle: 16-seater sharing open safari bus.
   - Price: ₹2,299 per person (Indian nationals).
   - Inclusions: Dhikala core zone entry permit, seat on Canter, authorized wildlife guide, Ramnagar/Dhangarhi Gate pickup & drop.
   - Quota: Strictly 4 Canters per shift (total 64 seats/shift).
   - Season: 15 November to 15 June (closed during monsoon).
   - URL: https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/canter-safari

2. **Exclusive 4x4 Jeep Safari (Gypsy):**
   - Vehicle: Registered private Maruti Gypsy 4x4 (Maximum 6 adults + 2 children under 5).
   - Starting Price: ₹5,999 to ₹8,499 per jeep depending on zone and advance booking window.
   - Core Zones: Bijrani, Jhirna, Dhela, Garjiya, Durga Devi.
   - Buffer Zones: Phato, Hathidangar, Sitabani.
   - Inclusions: Zone permit, registered 4x4 Gypsy, fuel, licensed driver, authorized forest naturalist/guide, pickup and drop within 5 km of Ramnagar town.
   - URL: https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/jeep-safari

3. **Forest Rest House (FRH) Core Night Stays:**
   - Accommodation: Dhikala FRH (32 rooms), Gairal FRH (6 rooms), Bijrani FRH (6 rooms).
   - Distinct Privilege: Guests staying inside FRHs are the only individuals permitted inside the core forest before day safaris open and after afternoon gates close.
   - Quota Opening: Exactly 45 days in advance at 00:00 IST for Indian nationals; 90 days for foreign nationals.
   - URL: https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/forest-rest-houses/dhikala-forest-rest-house

4. **Delhi to Jim Corbett All-Inclusive Packages:**
   - Duration: 1 Night/2 Days, 2 Nights/3 Days.
   - Inclusions: Private doorstep AC cab transfers from Delhi NCR (Swift Dzire), 3-star or 4-star jungle resort stay, breakfast & dinner, confirmed core zone safaris, government permits, all tolls and driver fees.
   - Pricing: Starting ₹20,999/couple (1N/2D) | ₹24,999/couple (2N/3D) | Weekend ex-Ramnagar from ₹11,999/couple.
   - URL: https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/delhi-to-jim-corbett-package

5. **Delhi to Jim Corbett Private Cab Service:**
   - Route: Delhi / Gurgaon / Noida / Ghaziabad to Ramnagar (250 km, ~5 to 6 hours via NH-9).
   - Sedan (Swift Dzire / Toyota Etios): ₹4,500 one way | ₹9,000 round trip (All inclusive: tolls, state tax, driver allowance).
   - MUV (New Ertiga 6+1): ₹6,000 one way | ₹12,000 round trip.
   - SUV (Toyota Innova Crysta 6+1): ₹8,500 one way | ₹17,000 round trip.
   - URL: https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/delhi-corbett-cab

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dhikala | Core Zone | Dhangarhi Gate (18 km) | 15 Nov – 15 Jun | Canter (4/shift, 16 seats each); Jeeps for FRH guests only | ₹2,299 / person | Bengal tigers, wild elephant herds, gharials, hog deer. Vast grasslands (Chaurs) and Ramganga reservoir. |
| Bijrani | Core Zone | Amdanda Gate (1 km) | 15 Oct – 30 Jun | 4x4 Gypsy (30 jeeps/shift) | ₹7,999 / jeep (up to 6 pax) | Highest tiger sighting probability. Dense sal forest, clear streams, rolling meadows. |
| Jhirna | Core Zone | Dhela Gate (20 km) | Open 365 Days (All Year) | 4x4 Gypsy (30 jeeps/shift) | ₹7,999 / jeep (up to 6 pax) | Sloth bears, tigers, wild elephants, sambar. Open dry deciduous forest with riverbeds. |
| Dhela | Core Zone | Dhela Gate (20 km) | Open 365 Days (All Year) | 4x4 Gypsy (Strictly 15 jeeps/shift) | ₹7,999 / jeep (up to 6 pax) | Royal Bengal tigers, leopards, Asian elephants. Quiet, capped visitor numbers, active waterholes. |
| Garjiya | Core Zone | Garjiya Gate (12 km) | 15 Oct – 30 Jun | 4x4 Gypsy (30 jeeps/shift) | ₹7,999 / jeep (up to 6 pax) | High tiger movement corridor along the scenic Kosi riverbed. |
| Durga Devi | Core Zone | Durga Devi Gate (28 km) | 15 Oct – 15 Jun | 4x4 Gypsy (15 jeeps/shift) | ₹7,999 / jeep (up to 6 pax) | Hilly terrain, Ramganga & Mandal river valleys, golden mahseer, crested serpent eagle, leopards. |
| Phato | Buffer Zone | Phato Gate (26 km) | Open 365 Days (All Year) | 4x4 Gypsy (50 jeeps/shift) | ₹6,499 / jeep (up to 6 pax) | High tiger activity, wooden forest treehouse, dense mixed teak and sal jungle. |
| Hathidangar | Buffer Zone | Ampokhra Gate (15 km) | Open 365 Days (All Year) | 4x4 Gypsy | ₹6,499 / jeep (up to 6 pax) | Major wild elephant transit corridor, tranquil birding trails. |
| Sitabani | Landscape Reserve | Teda / Bhandarpani / Pawalgarh | Open 365 Days (All Year) | 4x4 Gypsy (Flexible quota) | ₹5,999 – ₹6,499 / jeep | Historic Sitabani temple, peacocks, deer, elephants, zero quota stress. |

## 4. Safari Pricing Schedule (2025–26)

### Indian Citizens:
- **Dhikala Canter Safari:** ₹2,299 per person (Fixed year-round)
- **Core Zone Jeep Safari (Bijrani / Jhirna / Dhela / Garjiya / Durga Devi):**
  - Advance Booking (>5 days prior): ₹7,999 per jeep
  - Urgent / Same-Day Booking: ₹8,499 per jeep
- **Buffer Zone Jeep Safari (Phato / Hathidangar):** ₹6,499 per jeep (Fixed)
- **Sitabani Reserve Safari:** ₹5,999 per jeep (Teda/Bhandarpani Gate) | ₹6,499 per jeep (Pawalgarh Gate)

### Foreign Nationals:
- **Dhikala Canter Safari:** ₹4,500 per person (Includes higher Forest Dept permit fees)
- **Core Zone Jeep Safari:** ₹14,000 to ₹16,000 per jeep (Includes foreign quota government entry taxes)

### What Every Safari Booking Includes:
1. Confirmed Forest Department entry permit for the specified zone.
2. Exclusive registered 4x4 Gypsy (or confirmed Canter seat).
3. Registered wildlife driver and fuel.
4. Authorized government-appointed naturalist guide.
5. Road taxes, entry surcharges, and GST.
6. Complimentary pickup and drop within Ramnagar town limits.

## 5. Tour Packages Breakdown
1. **Delhi to Jim Corbett All-Inclusive Package 1N/2D & 2N/3D (From ₹20,999/couple):**
   - Day 1: 06:00 AM doorstep pickup in Delhi NCR in private AC Sedan (Swift Dzire). Reach Ramnagar by 12:30 PM, check-in to 3-star jungle resort. Afternoon leisure or safari. Dinner at resort.
   - Day 2: Dawn or evening private 4x4 Gypsy core safari in Bijrani or Garjiya zone with registered naturalist. Breakfast at resort, check-out, and return private drive to Delhi NCR.
   - Includes: Round-trip Delhi AC cab, 1 night resort stay (double occupancy), 1 private core safari, dinner & breakfast, tolls, permits, driver allowance. (2N/3D extension from ₹24,999/couple).

2. **Bijrani Weekend Safari 1N/2D (From ₹11,999/couple ex-Ramnagar):**
   - Day 1: Arrive in Ramnagar, check-in at 3-star jungle resort, relax and enjoy resort amenities, dinner.
   - Day 2: Dawn Bijrani core jeep safari (06:00 AM – 09:30 AM), breakfast at resort, checkout.
   - Includes: 1 night 3-star resort, 1 private core safari in Bijrani, breakfast & dinner, permits, guide. (2-safari package from ₹19,999/couple).

3. **Double Zone Day Safari (₹15,999/jeep for up to 6 guests):**
   - Morning: Dawn jeep safari in Bijrani core zone (dense sal forest).
   - Afternoon: Afternoon jeep safari in Garjiya or Jhirna core zone (riverbed terrain).
   - Includes: 2 core zone safaris in 1 day, private 4x4 Gypsy for up to 6 people, both core permits and guides. (~₹2,666/person).

4. **Dhikala Forest Rest House 2N/3D Immersion (₹35,000/couple):**
   - Day 1: Afternoon entry via Dhangarhi Gate, check-in to Dhikala/Gairal FRH, 1st evening Gypsy safari along Sambar Road.
   - Day 2: Dawn Gypsy safari to Dhikala Chaur & Ramganga reservoir; afternoon rest; evening safari to crocodile point and high banks.
   - Day 3: Morning Gypsy drive, breakfast at FRH canteen, checkout and exit through Dhangarhi Gate.
   - Includes: 2 nights FRH room, 4 exclusive Gypsy safaris, guide, all permits, all canteen meals.

5. **Dhikala Canter Day Trip (₹2,299/person):**
   - Half-day excursion: 16-person sharing open Canter safari into Dhikala core zone.
   - Includes: Official Dhikala core permit, confirmed Canter seat, guide, Ramnagar pickup/drop.

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions (Master FAQ Corpus)

### Q: Which safari is best: Jeep or Canter?
**A:** A Jeep safari offers complete privacy, exclusivity for up to 6 guests, and greater agility to navigate narrow forest tracks. It is best for Bijrani, Jhirna, Dhela, and Garjiya. A Canter safari is a 16-person sharing bus, but it is the ONLY mode of day transport permitted into the world-famous Dhikala core zone without an overnight Forest Rest House reservation. For Dhikala day visits, Canter is mandatory; for all other zones, private Jeep is recommended.

### Q: How far in advance should I book my safari?
**A:** For core zones (Bijrani, Dhikala Canter, Jhirna, Dhela), book 30 to 45 days in advance, as government quotas are capped strictly. For weekends, Christmas, New Year, and holidays, book 60 days ahead. For buffer zones (Phato, Sitabani), booking is possible on 24 to 48 hours notice.

### Q: Is Jim Corbett National Park open all year round?
**A:** Yes. Jhirna Zone, Dhela Zone, Phato Zone, and Sitabani Reserve remain open all 365 days of the year, including the monsoon months (July, August, September). Dhikala, Bijrani, and Garjiya close between mid-June and mid-October/November for animal breeding and road repair.

### Q: What documents are required to book a safari?
**A:** Every visitor must provide full name, age, gender, and government photo ID number (Aadhaar Card, Passport, or Voter ID). For foreign citizens, passport copy and visa details are mandatory. The original physical ID must be carried on the safari.

### Q: Can permits be cancelled or rescheduled?
**A:** No. Under Corbett Tiger Reserve and Uttarakhand Forest Department regulations, permits once confirmed are 100% non-transferable, non-amendable, and non-refundable.

### Q: What is included in the safari package price?
**A:** All bookings through Panthera Corbett Safari are fully inclusive of: Forest Department entry permit fees, road tax, vehicle hire (Gypsy or Canter), government-certified driver, government naturalist guide fee, and complimentary pickup/drop within Ramnagar.

---

## 8. Forest Department Rules & Reserve Code of Conduct
1. **Dress in Earth Tones:** Wear khaki, olive green, brown, or beige clothing. Bright neon colors disturb wild animals.
2. **Strict Silence:** Maintain absolute silence inside the reserve. Shouting, playing music, or honking is an offense.
3. **Never Disembark:** Stepping out of your Gypsy or Canter inside the tiger reserve is strictly illegal and dangerous.
4. **Zero Plastic Policy:** Single-use plastic polybags, disposable bottles, and littering are strictly forbidden in Corbett.
5. **No Smoking or Alcohol:** Smoking and consuming alcohol inside the park is illegal and attracts severe Forest Department prosecution.
6. **No Night Movement:** Private vehicles are not allowed to move inside forest gates after sunset.
